title: National Vulnerability Database: enrichment layer for vulnerability management and software-failure linkage
summary: NVD is encoded as a vulnerability enrichment and lookup layer: it makes CVE-indexed vulnerability data more queryable through severity/product/weakness metadata, but it is not an incident-investigation body and does not itself prove exploit, patch status, or cause.

status_history.note: Promoted in rev0010 as vulnerability/source-infrastructure rail for the software failure lane.

claims.claim: NVD describes itself as the U.S. government repository of standards-based vulnerability-management data represented using SCAP, supporting automation of vulnerability management, security measurement, and compliance.
what_would_change_status: NIST/NVD changes the repository scope or SCAP-based role statement.

evidence_migration.note: rev0016 removes overloaded source_support.source_id/record_id keys and uses typed evidence_refs with ref_kind and support_role.

claims.claim: NVD states that it enriches CVE records using references and public information, including CVSS, CWE, CPE, applicability statements, and prioritization that includes CVEs in CISA KEV; this makes NVD an enrichment layer rather than merely a name list.
what_would_change_status: NVD changes enrichment scope, schema, or prioritization rules.

evidence_migration.note: rev0016 removes overloaded source_support.source_id/record_id keys and uses typed evidence_refs with ref_kind and support_role.

evidence_profile.source_depth: one-pass official/institutional source extraction; no coverage or outcome audit
limitations: Establishes infrastructure existence and declared function only.
Does not claim completeness, timeliness, exploit prevalence, patch compliance, or incident-prevention effect.

signal_capture_model: prioritization of some records including CISA KEV
limitations: not exploit confirmation for every vulnerability
enrichment lag and coverage constraints require audit
type_payload.query_value: Lets the cube connect public vulnerability naming to patch/asset-management and breach records while preserving that operational failures also occur outside vulnerability databases.

handling_notes: Vulnerability infrastructure records should not become exploit catalogues; keep to identifier, enrichment, prioritization, and remediation-governance roles.
Do not infer patch status, exploitation, or blame from mere presence/absence in a vulnerability catalog without record-specific evidence.

unknowns: Coverage, timeliness, enrichment lag, and real remediation effects are not audited.
Dynamic/403/source-index pages need archive/API pass where relevant.
next_actions: Sample records to test identifier-to-patch-to-incident linkage.
Create negative-control cases where vulnerability rails worked and incidents were averted.

revision_history.change: Claim support migrated to typed evidence_refs; factual claim text and statuses unchanged.
